request.style: English, slow neo-soul ballad, male and female duet, Rhodes electric piano, warm strings, soft bass, brushed drums, gentle gospel backing vocals, intimate and grateful, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I kept a ledger in my head of every wrong and right
Counting up my better days and lying awake at night
Thought that I could earn a place if I just tried some more
Pay a debt I couldn't pay and knock on heaven's door

[Verse]
But God, who is rich in mercy, found me dead in all my sin
Because of the great love he had, he made me live again
He made me alive together with Christ, though I had nothing to bring
And raised me up and seated me with him beside the King

[Chorus]
By grace you have been saved through faith
And this is not from yourselves
It is the gift of God
Not from works, so that no one may boast

[Verse]
There's a thorn I've carried and I begged him, take it away
Three times I pleaded with the Lord, three times I knelt to pray
But he did not remove it, and he gave a better word
The truest answer to a prayer that I have ever heard

[Bridge]
My grace is enough for you
For my power is brought to its fullness in weakness
When I am weak, then I am strong

[Chorus]
By grace you have been saved through faith
And this is not from yourselves
It is the gift of God
Not from works, so that no one may boast

[Outro]
It is the gift of God
Grace, only grace
